cat >> tests/test_generate.py <<'EOF'


def _generate_n(conn, lumen, user_id, n, prefix="req"):
    return [generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, f"p{i}", f"{prefix}-{i}") for i in range(n)]


def test_free_plan_daily_image_limit(conn, lumen, user_id):
    responses = _generate_n(conn, lumen, user_id, 6)
    assert all(r["ok"] for r in responses[:5])
    sixth = responses[5]
    assert not sixth["ok"]
    assert sixth["error_code"] == "daily_image_limit"
    assert sixth["job_id"] is None
    assert "5 images" in sixth["message"]
    assert len(lumen.calls) == 5
    assert get_balance(conn, user_id) == 90


def test_daily_image_limit_message_is_localized(conn, lumen, user_id):
    _generate_n(conn, lumen, user_id, 5)
    response = generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "p", "req-6", locale="ru")
    assert response["message"] == t("errors.daily_image_limit", "ru", limit=5)
    assert "5 изображений" in response["message"]


def test_image_limit_resets_at_utc_midnight(conn, lumen, user_id):
    clock.set_now(datetime(2026, 3, 1, 23, 59, tzinfo=timezone.utc))
    _generate_n(conn, lumen, user_id, 5)
    assert not generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "p", "req-6")["ok"]

    clock.set_now(datetime(2026, 3, 2, 0, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc))
    assert generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "p", "req-7")["ok"]


def test_image_quota_is_keyed_by_utc_day(conn, lumen, user_id):
    # 20:00 at UTC-5 is 01:00 the next day in UTC.
    local = timezone(timedelta(hours=-5))
    clock.set_now(datetime(2026, 3, 1, 20, 0, tzinfo=local))
    _generate_n(conn, lumen, user_id, 1)
    assert quota.used(conn, user_id, "image", "2026-03-02") == 1
    assert quota.used(conn, user_id, "image", "2026-03-01") == 0


def test_retry_does_not_take_quota(conn, lumen, user_id):
    _generate_n(conn, lumen, user_id, 5)
    again = generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "p0", "req-0")
    assert again["ok"]
    assert quota.used(conn, user_id, "image") == 5
    assert len(lumen.calls) == 5


def test_pro_plan_is_unlimited(conn, lumen, pro_user_id):
    responses = _generate_n(conn, lumen, pro_user_id, 7)
    assert all(r["ok"] for r in responses)
    assert quota.used(conn, pro_user_id, "image") == 0


def test_image_and_video_quotas_are_separate(conn, lumen, user_id):
    callback = "https://pixforge.test/hooks/lumen"
    assert start_video(conn, lumen, user_id, "v", "vid-1", callback)["ok"]
    assert start_video(conn, lumen, user_id, "v", "vid-2", callback)["ok"]
    assert generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "p", "req-1")["ok"]
    assert quota.used(conn, user_id, "image") == 1


def test_filtered_image_releases_quota(conn, lumen, user_id):
    lumen.filter_next = True
    assert not generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "p", "req-1")["ok"]
    assert quota.used(conn, user_id, "image") == 0
    _generate_n(conn, lumen, user_id, 5, prefix="ok")
    assert quota.used(conn, user_id, "image") == 5


def test_provider_error_releases_quota(conn, lumen, user_id):
    lumen.fail_with = LumenAPIError(500, "internal", "boom")
    assert not generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "p", "req-1")["ok"]
    assert quota.used(conn, user_id, "image") == 0


def test_rate_limit_releases_quota(conn, lumen, user_id):
    lumen.fail_with = LumenRateLimited(5)
    assert not generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "p", "req-1")["ok"]
    assert quota.used(conn, user_id, "image") == 0


def test_insufficient_credits_releases_quota(conn, lumen):
    poor = create_user(conn, "poor@example.com", balance=1)
    assert not generate_image(conn, lumen, poor, "p", "req-1")["ok"]
    assert quota.used(conn, poor, "image") == 0


def test_racing_duplicate_request_rolls_back_quota(conn, lumen, user_id, monkeypatch):
    # Simulate a racing duplicate: the early duplicate check misses, so the
    # INSERT into jobs hits the UNIQUE(request_id) constraint.
    generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "p", "req-1")
    monkeypatch.setattr(jobs, "get_job_by_request", lambda conn, request_id: None)
    with pytest.raises(sqlite3.IntegrityError):
        generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "p", "req-1")
    assert quota.used(conn, user_id, "image") == 1
